hero_subhead: From fresh interior walls to full exterior transformations, we deliver a professional finish on time and on budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: We handle everything from interior redecoration to exterior weatherproofing, using quality materials and proven techniques.

services.title: Interior Painting & Redecorating
services.desc: Refresh your living spaces with our interior painting service. We prepare surfaces properly, use premium paints, and protect your furnishings throughout.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and enhance your home's exterior. We tackle fascia, soffits, doors, windows, and rendered walls with weatherproof finishes.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Add texture and character with expert wallpapering. We handle pattern matching, difficult corners, and bespoke feature wall designs.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, and window frames finished to a professional standard. We sand, prime, and paint for a flawless result.

services.title: Plastering Preparation & Finishing
services.desc: Repair, skim, and finish damaged plaster before decoration. Our prep work ensures a smooth, lasting paint application.

services.title: Commercial Painting & Rebranding
services.desc: Transform retail and office spaces. We work around business hours and deliver reliable, durable finishes for commercial environments.

about_pullquote: We take pride in getting the detail right, and we finish what we start.
about_para_1: A.L Decorating has been serving Birmingham homes and businesses for over 12 years. Founded on the principle that good decoration should be reliable, affordable, and always delivered on time, we've built a reputation for attention to detail and honest advice. Whether it's a small refresh or a complete interior transformation, we approach every job with the same professionalism.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, we prepare surfaces properly, and we use materials that last. We're based in Maypole and know Birmingham's neighbourhoods inside out. We turn up when we say we will, and we leave your home spotless. That's not complicated—it's just the standard we believe every customer deserves.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About A.L Decorating

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge. Al was tidy, efficient, and the walls look immaculate. He sorted out a damp patch we hadn't noticed and advised us properly before painting over it. Would absolutely use again.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Needed our hallway and stairs done urgently before family visited. Al fitted us in, worked quickly without cutting corners, and the finish is perfect. Very fair pricing too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Catherine M.

reviews.text: Had a right mess after a water leak—plaster damaged, paint peeling everywhere. Al prepared everything properly, didn't just slap paint over the problem. Took his time, and it's transformed the room. Excellent tradesman.
reviews.author: James T.
